name: RustDesk
summary: RustDesk is open-source remote desktop software that a business runs on its own server. The free tier is community supported. The paid Server Pro plans add an audit log, two-factor authentication, a web console and, from the Basic plan, OIDC single sign-on. Paid plans start at $11.88 a month billed annually for 1 login user and 20 managed devices. The vendor states that it does not auto-renew licenses.

facts.text: The paid plans are self-hosted rather than a SaaS subscription, so the buyer runs the server.
RustDesk's client documentation says a permanent password can be set from the command line with the --password option.
Server Pro documentation lists log management for connections, file transfers and alarms as a Pro feature.
RustDesk offers annual plans only, does not auto-renew, and sends a renewal reminder 14 days before a license expires.
RustDesk charges an extra bank processing fee for bank transfers and sends the license key after the payment arrives, which takes 3 to 5 working days.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Open source with community support. Online status only.

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: Billed annually. Includes two-factor authentication, web console, audit log and access control.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Billed annually. Adds OIDC single sign-on, LDAP integration and a custom client generator.

plans.name: Customized
plans.notes: Billed annually. Extra users cost $1.20 each and extra devices $0.12 each.

plans.name: Customized V2
plans.notes: Billed annually. Limits concurrent connections. Extra users cost $1.20, extra devices $0.12 and extra concurrent connections $24 each.

hiddenCosts: Every paid plan needs the buyer's own server to host the RustDesk service.
Bank transfers carry an extra bank processing fee.
RustDesk says it has no non-profit or education discount.
